incidents.what_happened: Two men on a trip from Cuddalore went into deep water while bathing in the Cauvery near Hogenakkal and were washed away.
incidents.quote: Two persons on a trip from Cuddalore drowned while bathing in the Cauvery River near Hogenakkal in Dharmapuri on Monday.
